alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued November 25 at 5:12AM EST until November 27 at 3:00AM EST by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.desc:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level
possible in low lying areas due to tidal flooding.

* WHERE...Shoreline in the District of Columbia, Arlington
County, and the City of Alexandria.

* WHEN...From Thursday afternoon through late Thursday night,
especially around the time of high tide.

* IMPACTS...Water may approach buildings near King Street and
Union Street in Alexandria. Flooding is possible at the DC
seafood market and in portions of East Potomac Park. Water may
cover the boardwalk at Washington Harbour. Low-lying areas near
Fletchers Boathouse may flood. Portion

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 25 at 1:48AM EST until November 26 at 4:00PM EST by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.desc:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph
expected.

* WHERE...District of Columbia, central, north central, northeast,
northern, southern, and western Maryland, northern and northwest
Virginia, and eastern and panhandle West Virginia.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 4 PM EST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The combination of a soaking rain and very
windy conditions could result in many downed trees.
